name.full: MCP OAuth Test Plugin for Copilot Cowork

description.short: Test tools behind an OAuth 2.0 protected MCP server.
description.full: Verifies the Copilot Cowork plugin authentication flow end to end. Signs the user in with OAuth 2.0 against a self-hosted authorization server, then calls MCP tools that report the signed-in identity, token details and per-user tasks.

agentConnectors.description: Remote MCP server protected with OAuth 2.0. Tools: whoami, get_token_info, list_my_tasks, create_task, force_unauthorized.
